name: Design Project-3
description: The student will be able to practice the design process to solve a challenging design problem. The student should exhibit the sensitivity to the multidimensionality of the problems in the design domain. They should be able to prove their design outcome as viable and practice solution for the given problem. The students are expected to exhibit their work to the professional community.
